chapter6_improvements: Chen's refusal remains costly and attractive: no moral reward follows the rejection.
Gao no longer proves that sunk cost is absent; he explicitly cannot know the counterfactual, preserving the core ambiguity of his long arc.
Removed the analytical salary-rent-commute list as a symbolic self-diagnosis device.
Removed Lin's authorial certification of Gao's decision; she repeatedly says she does not know because she is not the one taking the job.
The ending stays inside administrative reality: medical-exam timing and an alarm, not a life-choice summary.
first_six_sequence: Ch1 Zhou: call — reliable work seeks external evidence
Ch2 Song ensemble: ordinary world — weak ties and ordinary time
Ch3 Luo: trial — credentials meet actual institutional labor
Ch4 Tang: trial — evidence splits and preferred phenomenon weakens
Ch5 Zhou/Gao/Luo: partial payoff/threshold — earlier preparation receives contingent external results
Ch6 Chen/Gao: refusal + threshold — attractive offers produce opposite actions for character-specific reasons
part1_strengths: The opening now has causal residue: Ch1 is paid in Ch5, Ch3's route changes are visible in Ch5, and classmate ties persist without becoming a permanent team.
Campbell functions differ across people and are not synchronized into one formula.
Material stakes increase over time: code and credentials give way to rent, commute, income, family distance, response burden and start logistics.
No decision is retrospectively certified as universally correct.
part1_risks: The novel has used Lin Jing several times as a calibration partner; she should not become the next universal adviser after Xu Hang recedes.
Offer evaluation can become another version of spreadsheet fiction; later chapters should show the lived job before more bundle comparisons.
The first six chapters cover many career decisions. The next movement needs daily work, institutional friction, bodily fatigue and ordinary repetition before another major choice chapter.
Twenty-five chapters is currently provisional. Compress only after later sequence audit identifies a genuinely redundant chapter.
next_recommendation: Move into the 'work becomes life' movement. Favor a first-job daily-life chapter (Lin first week, Luo first months, or Zhou/He first-year reality) before another major offer or housing decision.
